evals.prompt: Build a .pptx from this content for an exec audience, using our brand palette (navy/white).
assertions: A real .pptx file is produced, not an outline
Audience, format and design are confirmed in a single setup block rather than as a trickle of separate questions
The title slide carries a real title, subtitle, presenter, and date — never left blank
Section dividers appear sparingly, at most one every 4-5 content slides
Big-number layouts use only numbers the user supplied; no statistic is invented for emphasis
Bullet density matches the stated audience rather than a fixed default
The requested palette is applied rather than the default theme

evals.prompt: Build the Q3 QBR deck on our corporate template at ~/brand/acme-master.potx — 25 minutes, live, partner audience.
assertions: The template's layouts are listed with --list-layouts before the spec is written, rather than layout names being guessed
The spec sets `template` and a `layout_map` covering at least title, section, content and closing
A palette is still collected, because the template does not colour charts, tables or big numbers
`aspect` is not fought with — the template's own slide size is accepted and stated
Slide count is derived from the 25-minute budget at roughly 2 minutes per slide

evals.prompt: Here are our renewal rates for the last three quarters (88%, 91%, 94%) and the SLA table from the contract. Put them in the deck.
assertions: The three comparable figures become a `chart` slide, not a bullet list
The chart carries a `takeaway` sentence and a `source`
The SLA data becomes a `table` slide rather than aligned bullets
No figure appears that the user did not supply
Any build warning (missing image, short series) is reported to the user with its path rather than left in the file

evals.prompt: Build the November board deck from ashby-vale-board-notes.md as a PowerPoint and save it as ashby-vale-board-nov.pptx. Everything you need should be in the notes.
assertions: Writes ashby-vale-board-nov.pptx, a valid PowerPoint file with no more than 6 slides
It states the decision the board is asked to make (approve drawing £250,000 from the loan facility to start Tanner's Yard in January 2027) clearly, not buried in a later bullet
It notices the notes disagree on how many Furlong Close homes are let (14 versus 12 of 14) and does not put either figure on a slide as settled without flagging it
It notices the net surplus (£89,650) does not match the lines above it (£85,650) and does not present the stated total as checked fact without flagging it
It does not make up five years of arrears data: it shows only 2024 to 2026 and tells the user the five-year trend the treasurer asked for cannot be drawn from the notes
At least some of the figures (finance or arrears) appear as a chart or table in the deck, as the notes ask, rather than only as bullet text
It does not invent figures, names, dates or achievements that are not in the notes

evals.prompt: need a powerpoint for the PTA meeting on thursday about the playground fundraiser. 3 slides max. we've raised £2,340 so far out of the £5,000 target, the bake sale did best, and we still want to do a sponsored walk in spring but haven't picked a date. can you do it?
assertions: Writes a .pptx file with no more than 3 slides
The figures are right: £2,340 raised of a £5,000 target, and any figure it works out is correct (£2,660 still to raise, about 47%)
It says the bake sale did best without making up how much it raised or what other events raised
The sponsored walk is shown as planned for spring with the date still to be decided; no date is invented
It does not invent other facts such as the school's name, people's names, numbers of families or deadlines
It delivers the file without asking questions first, and the reply is short and in plain words
